export_report.overlap_resolution: Higher objectness-mask score first; raw overlapping masks retained in instances.npz

inference_report.scale: Uncalibrated native units treated as meters
inference_report.attention: T4 compatibility: mathematically equivalent PyTorch SDPA with exact packed sequence boundaries

qualitative_review.basis: Same-camera projection comparison and original-RGB region previews; no ground truth
findings: 71 disjoint regions after 0.5 score threshold and overlap resolution; not 71 verified objects
Large wall regions coexist with many small surface fragments
Some furniture surfaces receive table/shelf/television labels, but clean complete chair/desk separation is not established
No selected masks labeled chair or desk in the 18-label vocabulary; this does not establish absence of those objects
qualitative_review.conclusion: Further input cleanup and instance boundary refinement needed before making object-complete GLB/OBJ meshes.

inference_report.adaptation: LingBot camera/depth adapter, official ScanNet superpoints on verified fused mesh; only CUDA device allocations patched in core helpers.
differences_from_benchmark: Synthetic RGB-D rendered from public viewer points, followed by TSDF mesh fusion; not original RGB-D

qualitative_review.basis: Manual visual inspection of projected same-camera views and PCA-fitted original-RGB region thumbnails; no ground truth

findings.observation: Large areas of the building envelope and floor merge into common regions.
Contains illuminated monitor screens and surrounding furniture, so it is not one clean monitor instance.
Parts of furniture are separated, but boundaries include fragments or nearby surfaces.

qualitative_review.semantic_vote_warning: Auxiliary 2D label votes are dominated by wall/floor detections and can be visibly incorrect; region IDs are the reliable output identifiers.
qualitative_review.conclusion: 18 separated regions do not mean 18 correctly isolated objects. Current render-input MV3DIS output is inadequate for automatic object-complete chair/desk meshes.

limitations: No ground-truth instance labels; assignment fraction is not accuracy.
Original RGB/depth frames and metric scale unavailable.
MV3DIS uses 24 synthetic RGB-D views rendered from the source point cloud.
Input sampling, surfaces and thresholds differ between the two methods.
Region counts are not verified physical object counts; exported PLY files are point clouds, not complete object meshes.
